[EVENT] User is looking for new board game recommendations.  
[EVENT] User has been having a monthly game night with friends, where they rotate hosting duties and try out new games.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been really into board games lately and is always looking to try out new ones.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant is happy to help with board game recommendations and suggests a mix of popular, modern, and diverse games.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended games include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Strategy and Complexity**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Gloomhaven: A cooperative campaign-based game with modular board and Legacy elements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Scythe: A worker placement game set in an alternate history of the 1920s, with engine-building and area control mechanics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pandemic Legacy: A cooperative game where players work together to save the world from diseases, with a Legacy system that changes the game over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Social Deduction and Party Games**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mysterium: A cooperative game where one player takes on the role of a ghost, guiding the other players to solve a murder mystery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Deception: Murder in Hong Kong: A social deduction game where one player is the investigator, and the others are suspects, with a unique "storytelling" mechanic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Codenames: A word-guessing game where players try to identify words based on one-word clues given by their teammate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Lighter, Fun, and Accessible**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Ticket to Ride: A popular train-themed game where players compete to build railroad routes across a map of North America.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sushi Go!: A fast-paced card game where players pick and pass cards to collect sets of sushi dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Forbidden Island/Forbidden Desert: A cooperative game where players work together to retrieve four treasures from an island/desert before it sinks/gets buried in sand.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Unique Mechanics and Themes**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Azul: A tile-laying game where players compete to create the most beautiful mosaic.
